issues.problem: No user card is selected on initial load; the first user gains its selected ring only after clicking.
issues.expected: First user auto-selected on page load.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; added explicit selection assertion to prevent a false pass based only on unrelated initial license records.

issues.problem: User and license Edit icon buttons have no accessible label; Delete buttons do.
issues.expected: Edit controls discoverable by their accessible names.
issues.classification: Independently observed accessibility issue. Existing Edit-name assertions retained.

issues.problem: Rapid typing sends one debounced request; revisiting page 1 and clearing search reuse cached results without a new GET.
issues.classification: Observed behavior conflicts with existing no-debounce/fresh-request expectations. Retained for requirement review, not automatically classified as a product defect.

issues.problem: Hardware-ID filtering returns matching users but the license panel includes their other hardware IDs as well.
issues.expected: Every displayed license hardware ID matches the search term.
issues.classification: Independently verified requirement failure; assertion retained.

issues.problem: Download becomes enabled after selecting a user even while All Profiles is active.
issues.expected: This scenario expects Download disabled until a specific profile is applied.
issues.classification: Verified requirement mismatch; original disabled-state assertion retained.

issues.tab: User & License Hub / Hardware search with selection
issues.problem: Changing the hardware search clears user selection and disables Download.
issues.expected: This scenario expects Download to remain enabled with a selected user and active profile.
issues.classification: Consistent with independently observed filter-induced selection reset; original assertion retained.

issues.tab: User & License Hub / Download after All Profiles reset
issues.problem: Download remains enabled after All Profiles is restored while a user remains selected.
issues.expected: The scenarios require Download disabled after restoring All Profiles.
issues.classification: Observed requirement mismatch consistent with Download requiring user selection but not a specific profile; disabled-state assertions retained.

issues.problem: Cancelling and reopening Add License retains the unsaved Hardware ID.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; no license submitted.

issues.problem: Opening Edit License places initial focus on a date input rather than the expected Role combobox. It remains on the input after the dialog settles.
issues.expected: Initial keyboard focus is on Role.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; assertions retained.

issues.problem: After Cancel closes the dialog, document focus falls back to BODY instead of returning to the Edit trigger.
issues.expected: Focus returns to the invoking Edit button.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; assertions retained.

issues.problem: The automated focus-trap assertion found no focused descendant after 15 Tab presses. An independent 15-Tab inspection kept document.activeElement inside the dialog on every step.
issues.expected: Keyboard focus stays within the modal.
issues.classification: Intermittent focus observation requires review; not classified as a confirmed application defect.
issues.followUp: LIMAS-SUD-1415 passed the final diagnostic rerun with activeInsideDialog=true, cssFocusedDescendants=1 and documentHasFocus=true. Earlier failures remain recorded; no underlying application fix is claimed.
